message.content: A bat and a ball cost 1.10 in total. The bat costs 1.00 more than the ball. Think it through, then give the ball's price in one short sentence.

Say one short sentence about what you are going to do, then use the Write tool to create notes.txt containing the single line 'gate'. Then read it back with the Read tool and reply with one short sentence.
Use the Agent tool to have a subagent read notes.txt and report its first line. Then reply with that line only.
